profile.headline: Sr. Principal Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman

positions.title: Engineer Sr Electrical
positions.description:
Programming and troubleshooting in Python, VB.Net, C#.Net, C, LabVIEW, VHDL, Octave/Matlab
Some work in Mentor Graphics for circuit board design
Test system troubleshooting and design
Technical documentation development
SQA (Software quality Assurance)
Presentations to all levels of management
Green Belt Certified
Design for Six Sigma Certified
Mentor new employee's

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
Development of firmware in C
Machine to Machine (M2M) connectivity
Investigate connectivity options (Bluetooth, Wifi, or M2M)
Work with test equipment for board bring up and debugging

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Run and analyze simulations, track hardware, download flight software
Assist with putting together CDR presentations as well as other documentation
Conduct software and simulation training
Write and manage user guide’s
User account management
Recipient of Boeing Pride Award
